description: This Java source file defines a Spring Shell component class 'MockCPEHalShell' that provides shell commands to simulate various states of a CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) for testing or mocking purposes. It includes methods for tampering, restoring tampering, setting and unsetting bad battery, low battery, and power removal conditions, delegating each operation to the static MockCPEHal class.

classes.name: MockCPEHalShell
classes.description: A Spring Shell component class providing mock commands for simulating CPE hardware states.

methods.name: cpeTamper
methods.description: Simulates tampering with the CPE by setting the tamper state to true.

methods.name: cpeTamperRestore
methods.description: Restores the CPE to its untampered state by setting the tamper state to false.

methods.name: cpeBatteryBad
methods.description: Simulates a bad battery condition on the CPE.

methods.name: cpeBatteryBadRestore
methods.description: Restores the battery to a non-bad state.

methods.name: cpeBatteryLow
methods.description: Simulates a low battery condition on the CPE.

methods.name: cpeBatteryLowRestore
methods.description: Restores the battery to a normal state after low battery.

methods.name: cpeAcPowerMissing
methods.description: Simulates removal of AC power from the CPE.

methods.name: cpeAcPowerRestored
methods.description: Restores the AC power to the CPE.
